OpcodeAgg.doc: Aggregate lifecycle opcodes. Each opcode addresses one accumulator slot + the function kind pinned at Reset. Step feeds rows; Final reads+consumes; Value reads non-destructively. Slot indices are u32 into VdbeState's internal aggregate store; the compiler assigns them.

AggReset.doc: Reset the accumulator at acc_slot to its kind-specific initial state. Subsequent Step/Final/Value on this slot operate under this kind until the next Reset.

AggStep.doc: Apply regs[arg_reg] to the accumulator at acc_slot. For GroupConcat, separator_reg names the Register holding the user-supplied separator (None → default ','). For other kinds, separator_reg is ignored. NULL-skip rule (all kinds except CountStar skip NULL arguments) is enforced by state.aggregate_step — the opcode does not branch on value kind.

AggFinal.doc: Finalize the accumulator at acc_slot and install the result into regs[dest_reg]. After Final, the slot must be Reset before next use.

AggValue.doc: Read the current accumulator value without finalizing. The slot remains live — further Step calls continue to accumulate. Used by WINDOW's per-row read and by HAVING after group close.

execute.doc: Execute one aggregate-family opcode against state. All opcodes return Continue on success; no jump or halt paths except OpcodeIllegal from out-of-range slot/register (unreachable in well-formed code).
